Additional 5% NeuCoins via NeuPass on selected Tata Neu categories, on top of the base/brand reward where applicable.

These transactions are not eligible for the additional 5% NeuCoins through NeuPass.
Eligible UPI transactions earn 0.50% NeuCoins.
Additional 1% NeuCoins on eligible UPI payments made using Tata Neu UPI ID, making total eligible UPI earn up to 1.5%.
NeuCoins are not accrued on fuel transactions.
NeuCoins are not accrued on wallet loads, gift/prepaid card loads, voucher purchases or wallet reloads.
NeuCoins are not accrued on rental transactions.
NeuCoins are not accrued on government-related transactions.

No NeuCoins are earned on online skill-based gaming transactions, MCC 5816.
NeuCoins are not accrued on cash advances.
Payments of outstanding balances do not earn NeuCoins.
Card fees and other charges do not earn NeuCoins.
Smart EMI, Dial an EMI and post-transaction EMI conversion transactions do not earn NeuCoins.
From 1-Sep-2024, education payments through third-party apps/aggregators do not earn NeuCoins.
Education payments made directly through college/school websites or their POS machines earn NeuCoins.
Insurance transactions earn NeuCoins subject to a maximum of 2,000 NeuCoins per calendar month from 1-Jul-2025.
NeuCoins on grocery transactions are capped at 2,000 NeuCoins per month.
NeuCoins on utility transactions are capped at 2,000 NeuCoins per calendar month.
NeuCoins on Telecom & Cable transactions are capped at 2,000 NeuCoins per calendar month.

fee_waiver_rules.notes: Spend ₹3,00,000 or more during the year before the credit-card renewal date.

benefits.label: 2 complimentary domestic lounge vouchers per calendar quarter, up to 8 per calendar year, after ₹50,000 qualifying spend in that calendar quarter

conditions.net_spend_basis: Qualifying spend in the relevant calendar quarter.

perks: Effective 10-Jun-2025, domestic lounge access became milestone-based and is provided through lounge vouchers rather than direct swipe access.
Voucher must be claimed through HDFC Bank's lounge claim process within the applicable claim period.
The voucher can be used at participating domestic airport lounges subject to the voucher's validity and lounge terms.

benefits.label: 4 complimentary international lounge visits per calendar year, 1 per quarter, outside India for Visa variant

perks: Priority Pass is issued for the Visa variant subject to HDFC Bank's applicable issuance process.
Primary cardholder and add-on member can together use up to 4 complimentary visits per calendar year.
Guest visits are chargeable at US$27 plus applicable taxes per guest per visit.
Priority Pass visits within India are chargeable at US$27 plus applicable taxes per person per visit.

benefits.label: 4 complimentary international lounge visits per calendar year, 1 per quarter, outside India for RuPay variant

perks: For the RuPay variant, a US$3.25 transaction is charged and reversed for each complimentary international lounge visit, subject to the applicable RuPay lounge program.

benefits.label: Air Accidental Death
benefits.description: Available to the primary cardholder for death resulting from an air accident, subject to the applicable insurance policy terms. The audited policy document covered 23-Jul-2025 through 22-Jul-2026.

benefits.label: Medical Emergency Overseas
benefits.description: Up to ₹15 lakh for emergency medical expenses arising from bodily injury or sudden unexpected sickness during international travel outside India, subject to policy terms. Maximum trip duration 30 days; pre-existing illness excluded in the audited policy.

benefits.label: Other
benefits.description: Lost card liability cover up to ₹9 lakh for the primary cardholder, subject to policy terms. The audited policy specified cover for 2 days prior to blocking and 30 days after blocking, with additional activation and dispatch conditions.

unlock_rules.label: 2 complimentary domestic lounge vouchers per calendar quarter, up to 8 per calendar year, after ₹50,000 qualifying spend in that calendar quarter
